leaves.original_requirement: Implement progress indicators and status messages; distinguish determinate progress from loading and avoid noisy live-region announcements.

This closes the implementation/noisy-default requirement, not spoken announcement conformance.

leaves.original_requirement: Implement Avatar/image fallbacks and accessible image labeling; keep sizing and aspect ratio stable while loading.

ThemeScope copies theme/density/interaction/variables, dir/lang into portals. Native collision spec already covers four placements, light/dark, LTR/RTL, enlarged text, edge/scroll hosts, bounds/hit testing and retained draft/focus. Actual browser zoom and full overlay families remain open.
